leaderboard = [
    {"name": "all-MiniLM-L6-v2", "params_m": 22, "dims": 384, "max_tokens": 256, "retrieval": 41.9},
    {"name": "bge-small-en-v1.5", "params_m": 33, "dims": 384, "max_tokens": 512, "retrieval": 51.7},
    {"name": "bge-base-en-v1.5", "params_m": 109, "dims": 768, "max_tokens": 512, "retrieval": 53.3},
    {"name": "nomic-embed-text-v1.5", "params_m": 137, "dims": 768, "max_tokens": 8192, "retrieval": 53.0},
    {"name": "e5-large-v2", "params_m": 335, "dims": 1024, "max_tokens": 512, "retrieval": 50.6},
    {"name": "Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B", "params_m": 600, "dims": 1024, "max_tokens": 32768, "retrieval": 60.1},
]

def recommend(models, max_params_m, min_tokens, max_dims):
    # 1. Filter by the three hard constraints
    survivors = [
        m for m in models
        if m["params_m"] <= max_params_m
        and m["max_tokens"] >= min_tokens
        and m["dims"] <= max_dims
    ]
    # 2. Return None if nothing survives
    if not survivors:
        return None
    # 3. Pick highest retrieval; tie-break toward smaller params_m
    best = min(survivors, key=lambda m: (-m["retrieval"], m["params_m"]))
    return best["name"]

print(recommend(leaderboard, 150, 512, 768))
print(recommend(leaderboard, 150, 2000, 768))
print(recommend(leaderboard, 1000, 512, 1024))
print(recommend(leaderboard, 10, 512, 768))

assert recommend(leaderboard, 150, 512, 768) == "bge-base-en-v1.5"
assert recommend(leaderboard, 150, 2000, 768) == "nomic-embed-text-v1.5"
assert recommend(leaderboard, 1000, 512, 1024) == "Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B"
assert recommend(leaderboard, 10, 512, 768) is None
assert recommend(leaderboard, 40, 512, 384) == "bge-small-en-v1.5"
tie = [
    {"name": "big", "params_m": 300, "dims": 768, "max_tokens": 512, "retrieval": 55.0},
    {"name": "small", "params_m": 100, "dims": 768, "max_tokens": 512, "retrieval": 55.0},
]
assert recommend(tie, 500, 512, 768) == "small"
print("All tests passed!")

challenges.code:
models = [
    {"name": "bge-small-en-v1.5", "dims": 384},
    {"name": "bge-base-en-v1.5", "dims": 768},
    {"name": "e5-large-v2", "dims": 1024},
    {"name": "big-4096", "dims": 4096},
]

def storage_gb(num_chunks, dims):
    # float32 = 4 bytes per dimension; 1 GB = 1024 ** 3 bytes
    return round(num_chunks * dims * 4 / 1024 ** 3, 2)

def fits_budget(models, num_chunks, budget_gb):
    # Return names whose storage_gb(num_chunks, dims) <= budget_gb
    return [m["name"] for m in models if storage_gb(num_chunks, m["dims"]) <= budget_gb]

print(storage_gb(1_000_000, 384))
print(storage_gb(1_000_000, 4096))
print(fits_budget(models, 1_000_000, 4.0))

assert storage_gb(1_000_000, 384) == 1.43
assert storage_gb(1_000_000, 4096) == 15.26
assert storage_gb(0, 768) == 0.0
assert fits_budget(models, 1_000_000, 4.0) == ["bge-small-en-v1.5", "bge-base-en-v1.5", "e5-large-v2"]
assert fits_budget(models, 1_000_000, 2.0) == ["bge-small-en-v1.5"]
assert fits_budget(models, 1_000_000, 20.0) == ["bge-small-en-v1.5", "bge-base-en-v1.5", "e5-large-v2", "big-4096"]
print("All tests passed!")
